sourceLicense.notice: Static game mechanics/balance data extracted from AGPL-marked source. Extraction does not imply a separate permissive data license or grant Pokémon artwork/trademark rights.
sourceLicense.method: Independent TypeScript AST literal/enum reader; no upstream TypeScript, constructors, functions or conditions were executed.

fieldSemantics.ids: All IDs are original upstream IDs; regional IDs are not PokeAPI IDs.
fieldSemantics.enums: Name-to-original-value maps. PokemonType starts at Normal=0; UNKNOWN=-1.
fieldSemantics.forms: forms[] preserves explicit source array indices and only explicitly declared flags. Empty array means use the base species record. Upstream PokemonForm constructor defaults isStarterSelectable to explicit value ?? !formKey; this exporter does not apply constructor defaults.
fieldSemantics.starterCost: Present only on source starter rows. starterId is the raw declared family reference, not getStarter() method return. selectableStarterId is sourceId for selectable starters, otherwise declared starterId. Pikachu25 is separately selectable despite declared starterId172; do not collapse selected starter upgrade records. familyStarterCost is only a raw-reference convenience.
fieldSemantics.passives: passiveAbilityMode distinguishes scalar all-forms from indexed by-form source data. passiveAbilityIdsByForm preserves original numeric formIndex keys (scalar at key 0); forms[].passiveAbilityId reflects this literal mode without executing upstream behavior.
fieldSemantics.moves: levelMoves/TMs/form-specific lists remain raw source declarations; prevolution inheritance and learnset composition are not executed. EVOLVE_MOVE=0; RELEARN_MOVE=-1.
fieldSemantics.eggMoves: Only the direct source starter table row; empty means no own row. familyEggMoves is a separate declared-family lookup and does not imply starter-select eligibility. Pikachu25 has no own egg moves in starter selection even though family Pichu172 has a row.

notes: Evolution/form-change constructors are descriptive records (__class + static fields/args), never instantiated. Condition functions/calls/getters are markers with source locations.
No upstream registry initialization, default-constructor behavior, conditions, or move-list inheritance is executed.
preEvolutionIds/optional preEvolutionId are derived from all literal evolution target IDs; branch conditions are not evaluated.
Minun312.tms uses an upstream filter callback, so it is omitted and recorded rather than executed.
Raw static facts do not implement modifier stacks, passive hooks, transformations, boss shields, or combat rules.
